name: setup-manaflow-ai-tachyon-look
description: A whole cmux look built only from public surfaces, after the block-based terminals: theme files for color, the terminal palette and proportions (Tachyon, dark, the default; Tachyon Light), settings for a monospaced chat in a wide column and a session sidebar with folder, branch and agent state on every row, a stylesheet of cmux.agentPane.style/1 tokens that draws your prompt as a selected block and tool calls as raised cards, and a customize view for a status-first hover card. Remove it and everything you had comes back.

files.customize/cmux-app.json:
{
  "$schema": "https://cmux.dev/schemas/cmux-app/2.json",
  "manifestVersion": 2,
  "id": "local/customize",
  "name": { "en": "Tachyon sidebar" },
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "description": "Tachyon's hover card and sidebar rows: a status chip first, then the folder, branch and task, the way a modern terminal's session card reads; rows with the filling arc while work runs; the session as a monospaced prompt line in Session Info.",
  "engines": { "cmux": "^2.0" },
  "repository": "https://github.com/local/customize",
  "runtime": { "main": "main.js" },
  "implements": {
    "cmux.hovercard/1": { "export": "renderCard" },
    "cmux.sidebar.rows/1": { "export": "decorateRows" },
    "cmux.session.info.section/1": {
      "export": "renderPrompt",
      "title": "Prompt",
      "symbol": "terminal",
      "options": { "maxRows": 2 }
    }
  },
  "scopes": { "workspace:read": "Name the rows to decorate." },
  "activation": [
    "onInterface:cmux.hovercard/1",
    "onInterface:cmux.sidebar.rows/1",
    "onInterface:cmux.session.info.section/1"
  ],
  "files": ["main.js"]
}
files.themes/tachyon-light.json:
// Tachyon Light: the same modern terminal in daylight. Two tones of cool paper (the chrome and
// sidebar a step grayer than the content), a deep teal for the selected block, the active tab's
// underline, the cursor and Send, plum for work in progress, and a terminal palette dark enough
// to read on white.
{
  "name": "Tachyon Light",
  "description": "A modern terminal, light: two-tone cool paper, deep-teal selected blocks, monospaced output as cards.",

  "appearance.theme": "Builtin Light",
  "appearance.appTheme": "followTerminal",
  // background: near-white content. foreground: graphite ink. selection: teal at 20% over white.
  // accent: the teal deepened until it reads as text on white.
  "colors": { "background": "#fafbfb", "foreground": "#1d2023", "selection": "#c6e6e2", "accent": "#0f766e" },
  "appearance.accent": "theme",
  "ghostty": [
    "background = #fafbfb",
    "foreground = #1d2023",
    "cursor-color = #0f766e",
    "cursor-text = #fafbfb",
    "selection-background = #c6e6e2",
    "selection-foreground = #1d2023",
    "palette = 0=#1d2023",
    "palette = 1=#c0383c",
    "palette = 2=#1d7f50",
    "palette = 3=#8a6100",
    "palette = 4=#1f68a8",
    "palette = 5=#9139a8",
    "palette = 6=#0f766e",
    "palette = 7=#5d6266",
    "palette = 8=#6b7074",
    "palette = 9=#c2333a",
    "palette = 10=#18794a",
    "palette = 11=#855c00",
    "palette = 12=#1d64a6",
    "palette = 13=#8f34a8",
    "palette = 14=#0b7068",
    "palette = 15=#9aa0a3"
  ],
  // The terminal face: JetBrains Mono at 13 pt, a modern terminal face with tall lowercase and
  // clear zeros.
  "terminal.fontFamily": "JetBrains Mono",
  "terminal.fontSize": 13,

  "appearance.background": "none",
  "appearance.backgroundBlur": "none",
  "appearance.fontSmoothing": "antialiased",

  "appearance.chromeStyle": "two-tone",
  "appearance.borders": "default",
  "appearance.titleAreaTone": "subtleTone",
  "appearance.titleAreaContrast": 1,
  "appearance.focusIndicator": "tabs",
  "appearance.density": "compact",
  // Pending cmux#46780: square tabs with the active one underlined; block is the closest shape.
  // "appearance.tabShape": "block",
  // Pending cmux#46516: the selected sidebar row as a raised neutral card with an edge.
  // "appearance.selection": "neutral",

  "appearance.metrics.titlebarHeight": 36,
  "appearance.metrics.sidebarWidth": 248,
  "appearance.metrics.sidebarRowHeight": 34,
  "appearance.metrics.chromeFontSize": 13,
  "appearance.metrics.tabStripHeight": 34,
  "appearance.metrics.tabFontSize": 12,
  "appearance.metrics.tabMaxWidth": 320,
  "appearance.metrics.tabMinActiveWidth": 160,
  "appearance.metrics.tabMinInactiveWidth": 120,
  "appearance.metrics.columnGap": 0,
  "appearance.metrics.dividerThickness": 1,

  "appearance.sidebarSurface": "separate",
  "appearance.surfaces.sidebar.color": "#eef0f1",
  "appearance.surfaces.sidebar.opacity": 1,
  "sidebar.style": "standard",
  "sidebar.border": true,
  "sidebar.borderWidth": 1,
  "sidebar.sectionLook": "lines",

  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.color": "#fafbfb",
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.terminal.color": "#fafbfb",
  "appearance.surfaces.terminal.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.tabBar.color": "#eef0f1",
  "appearance.surfaces.tabBar.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.browserChrome.color": "#eef0f1",
  "appearance.surfaces.browserChrome.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.docks.color": "#eef0f1",
  "appearance.surfaces.docks.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.editor.color": "#fafbfb",
  "appearance.surfaces.editor.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.diff.color": "#fafbfb",
  "appearance.surfaces.diff.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.markdown.color": "#fafbfb",
  "appearance.surfaces.markdown.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.splitDivider.color": "#d5d9db",
  "appearance.surfaces.splitDivider.opacity": 1,

  "appearance.surfaces.settings.color": "#eef0f1",
  "appearance.surfaces.settings.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.internalPage.color": "#fafbfb",
  "appearance.surfaces.internalPage.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.newTabPage.color": "#fafbfb",
  "appearance.surfaces.newTabPage.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.home.color": "#fafbfb",
  "appearance.surfaces.home.opacity": 1,

  "appearance.statusIndicator.style": "arc",
  "appearance.statusIndicator.animation": "animated",
  "appearance.statusIndicator.color": "#8e4a87",
  "appearance.statusIndicator.thickness": 2,
  "appearance.statusIndicator.showAgentWorkingOnTabs": true,

  "browser.omnibar.glass": "off",
